business_problem: Dynamic Health Systems needed to scale proactive, motivational care planning because overloaded clinicians and rising chronic-care demand made paper-like care plans too static and labor intensive.
solution_summary: Dynamic Health Systems uses Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare, Microsoft Azure, Dynamics 365, and Azure OpenAI Service to support personalized care-planning assistants and patient engagement. Dynamic Health Systems needed to scale proactive, motivational care planning because overloaded clinicians and rising chronic-care demand made paper-like care plans too static and labor intensive. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in FHIR, governs access and lineage with Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare, runs transformation or AI logic on Azure OpenAI Service, and delivers outputs through Dynamics 365. Tickets, conversation history, knowledge articles, and operational context are consolidated into FHIR; Azure OpenAI Service applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Dynamics 365.
